title: FDR's Vatican communications via envoy Myron Taylor

tellings.quote: Remember that FDR was responsible for the communications with the Vatican about the [music] crashed Magenta craft.

plain: President Franklin Roosevelt is said to have handled communications with the Vatican about a craft that reportedly crashed at Magenta in Italy, through his envoy to the Vatican, Myron Taylor, in the 1940s. Michels says it himself, without naming a source, on an episode with a former presidential adviser named Harald Malmgren. If true, the American government and the Catholic Church would have shared a secret about a crashed craft before Roswell.
